name: Lend Condemnation
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one ally
Duration 1 hr./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You allow an ally to become the bearer of your justice. The target gains the ability to invoke one of your condemnations against a foe with a successful melee touch attack. The condemnation inflicts all the penalties and conditions you would inflict. Casting this spell also consumes one of your daily uses of the condemnation ability.
